I saved the finished note as a mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". I haven't sent it, and I posted a short confirmation in #coastal-team for Bettina.

It includes your addition that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It also keeps Sofia's other points:
- The rename date.
- The two businesses sharing "PHL".
- Moss's digest still showing "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The open question of whether the relabelled views were ever fixed.

It closes by asking June which saved views still use the old name and who will update them.

The draft is signed "Bettina", so read it over before you send it.
